all_legacy_paper_code_blocks.code:
encode country_i, gen(cid)
tsset cid t

*** More variables ****
gen coldwar=0
replace coldwar=1 if t>=1947 & t<=1990
gen R_per_GDP=R/rgdpna

*** Generate lagged variables
foreach var of varlist dummy_first_aid-eu_enlargement {
clonevar `var'_1=`var'
replace `var'_1=l.`var'
}

		*Generate Interaction Variables
		gen democxgdp_1=acemoglu_democ_1*lg_rgdpna_percap_1 if !mi(acemoglu_democ_1) & !mi(lg_rgdpna_percap_1)
		gen Z_democxgdp_1=Z_democracy_1*lg_rgdpna_percap_1 if !mi(Z_democracy_1) & !mi(lg_rgdpna_percap_1)
		gen polity2xgdp_1 = polity2_1*lg_rgdpna_percap_1 if !mi(polity2_1) & !mi(lg_rgdpna_percap_1)
		gen Cheibobxgdp_1 = Democ_dummy_1*lg_rgdpna_percap_1 if !mi(Democ_dummy_1) & !mi(lg_rgdpna_percap_1)
		gen W_BdMxgdp_1 = W_BdM_1*lg_rgdpna_percap_1 if !mi(W_BdM_1) & !mi(lg_rgdpna_percap_1)
		gen W_eprxgdp_1 = W_epr_1*lg_rgdpna_percap_1 if !mi(W_epr_1) & !mi(lg_rgdpna_percap_1)
		gen VDemxgdp_1 = v2x_polyarchy_1*lg_rgdpna_percap_1 if !mi(v2x_polyarchy_1) & !mi(lg_rgdpna_percap_1)

		*First generate lags
		xtset cid t
		clonevar Z_democracy_2=Z_democracy_1
		replace Z_democracy_2=l.Z_democracy_1
		clonevar Z_democracy_3=Z_democracy_2
		replace Z_democracy_3=l.Z_democracy_2
		clonevar Z_democracy_4=Z_democracy_3
		replace Z_democracy_4=l.Z_democracy_3
		clonevar Z_democracy_5=Z_democracy_4
		replace Z_democracy_5=l.Z_democracy_4	
		clonevar Z2_polity2_2 = Z2_polity2_1
		replace Z2_polity2_2=l.Z2_polity2_1
		clonevar Z2_cheibob_2 = Z2_cheibob_1
		replace Z2_cheibob_2=l.Z2_cheibob_1
		clonevar Z2_W_BdM_2 = Z2_W_BdM_1
		replace Z2_W_BdM_2 = l.Z2_W_BdM_1
		clonevar Z2_W_epr_2 = Z2_W_epr_1
		replace Z2_W_epr_2 = l.Z2_W_epr_1
		clonevar Z2_v2x_polyarchy_2 = Z2_v2x_polyarchy_1
		replace Z2_v2x_polyarchy_2 = l.Z2_v2x_polyarchy_1

		*Generate interaction term with multiple lags of Z
		gen Z_democxgdp_2=Z_democracy_2*lg_rgdpna_percap_1
		gen Z_democxgdp_3=Z_democracy_3*lg_rgdpna_percap_1
		gen Z_democxgdp_4=Z_democracy_4*lg_rgdpna_percap_1
		gen Z_democxgdp_5=Z_democracy_5*lg_rgdpna_percap_1
		gen Z2_polity2xgdp_2=Z2_polity2_2*lg_rgdpna_percap_1
		gen Z2_cheibobxgdp_2=Z2_cheibob_2*lg_rgdpna_percap_1
		gen Z2_W_BdMxgdp_2=Z2_W_BdM_2*lg_rgdpna_percap_1
		gen Z2_W_eprxgdp_2=Z2_W_epr_2*lg_rgdpna_percap_1
		gen Z2_VDemxgdp_2=Z2_v2x_polyarchy_2*lg_rgdpna_percap_1

rename iso3_o exporter
rename country_o exporter_name
rename iso3_d importer
rename country_d importer_name
gen DIST=ln(distance)
rename contiguity CNTG
rename common_language LANG
rename colony_ever CLNY
rename member_eu_joint EU_DGD
egen WTO_DGD=rowmax(member_gatt_joint member_wto_joint)
egen RTA_DGD=rowmax(agree_pta_goods agree_pta_services agree_fta agree_eia agree_cu agree_psa agree_fta_eia agree_cu_eia agree_pta)
rename agree_pta_goods PTA_GOODS_DGD
rename agree_pta_services PTA_SERVS_DGD
rename agree_fta FTA_DGD
rename agree_eia EIA_DGD
rename agree_cu CU_DGD
rename agree_psa PSA_DGD
rename agree_pta PTA_DGD
rename member_eu_o eu_exp
rename member_eu_d eu_imp
**************************************************************
*c. Adjust some names to facilitate combining with other data*
**************************************************************

*d. Keep only some variables*
*****************************
keep exporter importer year DIST CNTG LANG CLNY EU WTO RTA FTA gdp_pwt_cur_d gdp_pwt_cur_o
compress
save ${tmp_data}\dgd_sdid, replace

** Clean miscellaneous household variables 
gen owns_house = 0
replace owns_house = 1 if b_owns_house == 1

gen elec_access = 0
replace elec_access = 1 if b_elec_w_acc == 1

replace a_hectares = 0 if a_hectares == .

rename b_total_neighbors tot_neigh

rename b_neighbor_has_cistern neigh_cist
replace neigh_cist = 0 if neigh_cist == 2

rename b_last_grade_hoh last_grade_hoh

use "${source_data_folder}/indiv_loc_baseline1_pe1_baseline2_pe2_V8.dta", clear
destring num_domicilio_from_loc, replace

keep agno rbd cod_ense cod_grado let_cur mrun fec_nac_alu prom_gral asistencia sit_fin sit_fin_r
destring mrun, replace

foreach var in  simce_4to simce_8vo simce_2do NEM {
		cap drop Std_`var'
		gen Std_`var' = .
		cap sum `var' if sample2==1
		cap replace Std_`var'=(`var'-`r(mean)')/`r(sd)' if sample2==1
	}
	cap drop SimceIndex
	egen SimceIndex = rowmean(Std_simce_4to Std_simce_8vo Std_simce_2do)

gen TREATMENT = .
replace TREATMENT = 0 if b_cl_assignment == 3 									// no cistern
replace TREATMENT = 1 if b_cl_assignment == 2 & b_cistern_assignment == 0 		// no cistern, partial treatment
replace TREATMENT = 2 if b_cl_assignment == 2 & b_cistern_assignment == 1 		// cistern, partial treatment
replace TREATMENT = 3 if b_cl_assignment == 1  									// cistern, full treatment
		
		
* Define treatment variable as 1 if an individual is in a full-treatment cluster and 0 if an individual is in a control cluster. 
gen treatment = 1 if TREATMENT == 3
replace treatment = 0 if TREATMENT == 0
label var treatment "Cisterns Treatment"


* Drop unneeded variables 
drop TREATMENT b_cl_assignment b_cistern_assignment

*==============================================================================*
**## 2.2 Winsorize Household Expenditure
*==============================================================================*

/*
Winsorize household expenditure at the 97.5th percentile
*/
winsor2 a_total_exp, cuts(0 97.5) replace	
label var a_total_exp "Total Expenditure (Winsorized at 97.5th percentile)"

****************************
*5. Delete temporary files *
****************************

* initialise matrices
mat B_main = J(1,1,.)
mat N_main = J(1,1,.)

mat index = J(`N_iter',1,.)
mat B_jack = J(`N_iter',1,.)
mat N_jack = J(`N_iter',1,.)
mat B = J(1,1,.)
mat SE = J(1,1,.)
mat loCI = J(1,1,.)
mat hiCI = J(1,1,.)

* open data set
use ${usr_data}\data_sdid_large, clear

* main estimation
qui ppmlhdfe trade RTA_3, absorb(idt_ci idt_cj id_ci_cj brdr_time) cluster(id_ci_cj)

mat B_temp = e(b)
local B_main = B_temp[1,1]	
local N_main = e(N)

* run 1000 jackknife iterations
forval jiter=1(1)`N_jiter' {

	di "`jiter'"
		
	* open data set
	use ${usr_data}\data_sdid_large, clear	

	forval p=1(1)4 {

		preserve
		
		capture drop _merge_id_ci
		qui merge m:1 exporter using "${usr_data}\Simulation\data_sdid_large_jackknife_exporter`jiter'.dta"
		rename _merge _merge_id_ci
		capture drop _merge_id_cj
		qui merge m:1 importer using "${usr_data}\Simulation\data_sdid_large_jackknife_importer`jiter'.dta"
		rename _merge _merge_id_cj
		
		if `p'==1 {
			qui keep if _merge_id_ci==3
		}
		if `p'==2 {
			qui drop if _merge_id_ci==3
		}
		if `p'==3 {
			qui keep if _merge_id_cj==3
		}
		if `p'==4 {
			qui drop if _merge_id_cj==3
		}
		
		qui ppmlhdfe trade RTA_3, absorb(idt_ci idt_cj id_ci_cj brdr_time) cluster(id_ci_cj)

		mat B_temp = e(b)
		mat B_jack[(`jiter'-1)*`N_p'+`p',1] = B_temp[1,1]	
		mat N_jack[(`jiter'-1)*`N_p'+`p',1] = e(N)
		mat index[(`jiter'-1)*`N_p'+`p',1] = (`jiter'-1)*`N_p'+`p'
		
		restore
			
	}

foreach dtaset in small medium large {

	// load trade data
	use ${usr_data}/data_`dtaset'.dta, clear
	
	* preliminary variable definitions
	rename RTA_DGD RTA
	egen id_ci = group(exporter)
	egen id_cj = group(importer)

	* set panel IDs
	xtset id_ci_cj year, yearly

	* determine treatment cohorts
	egen first_treat=csgvar(RTA), tvar(year) ivar(id_ci_cj)

	* shift RTA/WTO 3 years forward for anticipation effects
	gen RTA_3 = F3.RTA
	egen first_treat_3=csgvar(RTA_3), tvar(year) ivar(id_ci_cj)
	gen WTO_3 = F3.WTO
	
	* define exclude dummy for three anticipation years
	gen exclude = (first_treat-1==year | first_treat-2==year | first_treat-3==year)
	
	// drop always-treated units
	drop if first_treat_3 == 1980

	// drop exits
	sort exporter importer year
	gen D_RTA = 0
	replace D_RTA = RTA-RTA[_n-1] if id_ci_cj==id_ci_cj[_n-1]
	egen exit = min(D_RTA), by(id_ci_cj)
	drop if exit==-1
	drop exit D_RTA

	// define 5-year interval
	gen int_5yr = mod(year,5)
	
	// define border-time ID
	gen brdr=1 if exporter!=importer
	replace brdr=0 if brdr==.
	egen brdr_time=group(brdr year)
	
	// define variables
	gen lnDIST = ln(DIST)
	gen lntrade = ln(trade)

	// save data set
	save ${usr_data}/data_sdid_`dtaset'.dta, replace

}

// A school is "adp" if there is an ADP principal by the end of the year	
	by rbd: egen aux_min_adp = min(year) if adp == 1
	egen min_adp=min(aux_min_adp), by(rbd)
	drop aux_min_adp
	
	cap drop t
	g t = year - min_adp 
	replace t = 0 if EverADP == 0
	
	
// Change principal: for placebo exercise
	xtset rbd year
	g change_ppal = 1 if id_prin != l.id_prin
	g YearPpalChange = year if change_ppal == 1 & year != 2008
	bys rbd: egen aux_MinYearPpalChange = min(YearPpalChange)
	egen MinYearPpalChange = min(aux_MinYearPpalChange), by(rbd)
	drop aux_MinYearPpalChange
	g t_pla = year - MinYearPpalChange
	
	g PostChangePpal = 1 if (year >= MinYearPpalChange)  & MinYearPpalChange <= 2011  & MinYearPpalChange >= 2010
	replace PostChangePpal = 0 if PostChangePpal == .

reference.code:
use ${tmp_data}\trade_wto, clear
**************************
*b. Add gravity variables*
**************************
joinby exporter importer year using ${tmp_data}\dgd_sdid, unmatched(master)
tab _m
********************************************************************************
*NOTE: About 2.6% of the observations in the trade data are not matched in DGD.*
*The reason is the coding of some countries in DGD, e.g., HKG is missing before* 
*1997. Given the small percent of mismatched observations, we should be fine.  *
********************************************************************************
drop _m
******************************************************************************************
*c. Make sure all gravity covariates, except distance, are set to zero for domestic trade*
******************************************************************************************
local gravvars "CNTG LANG CLNY EU WTO RTA FTA" 
foreach x of local gravvars{
replace `x'=0 if exporter==importer
}
*************************
*d. Check for duplicates*
*************************
duplicates list year exporter importer
*************************************
*e. Create some additional variables*
*************************************	
egen idt_ci = group(exporter year)
egen idt_cj = group(importer year)
egen id_ci_cj = group(exporter importer)
compress
save ${usr_data}\data_large, replace

use ${usr_data}\data_large.dta, clear
keep if exporter!=importer
collapse (sum) trade, by(exporter)
sort trade
gen sum_trade_cum=sum(trade)
egen sum_trade_all=sum(trade)
gen ratio= sum_trade_cum/sum_trade_all
drop if ratio<0.01
keep exporter
save ${tmp_data}\exp_small.dta, replace
rename exporter importer
save ${tmp_data}\imp_small.dta, replace
use ${usr_data}\data_large.dta, clear
joinby importer using ${tmp_data}\imp_small.dta
joinby exporter using ${tmp_data}\exp_small.dta
keep year exporter importer trade CLNY CNTG LANG DIST RTA_DGD WTO_DGD gdp_pwt_cur_d gdp_pwt_cur_o idt_ci idt_cj id_ci_cj
save ${usr_data}\data_medium.dta, replace

*g. Create small sample*
**************************
use ${usr_data}\data_large.dta, clear
keep if exporter!=importer
collapse (sum) trade, by(exporter)
sort trade
gen sum_trade_cum=sum(trade)
egen sum_trade_all=sum(trade)
gen ratio= sum_trade_cum/sum_trade_all
drop if ratio<0.02
keep exporter
save ${tmp_data}\exp_small.dta, replace
rename exporter importer
save ${tmp_data}\imp_small.dta, replace
use ${usr_data}\data_large.dta, clear
joinby importer using ${tmp_data}\imp_small.dta
joinby exporter using ${tmp_data}\exp_small.dta
keep year exporter importer trade CLNY CNTG LANG DIST RTA_DGD WTO_DGD gdp_pwt_cur_d gdp_pwt_cur_o idt_ci idt_cj id_ci_cj
save ${usr_data}\data_small.dta, replace
